diagnosis.summary: When shipping-expedited@v2 was published via change:doc-update-1039, the previous version shipping-expedited@v1 was not de-indexed. As a result, both v1 (specifying $24.95) and v2 (specifying $19.95) were indexed and retrieved in the trace, creating conflicting chunk results.

evidence.claim: shipping-expedited@v2 was published on 2026-06-15, updating express shipping cost from $24.95 to $19.95, but shipping-expedited@v1 remained indexed with 1/1 chunks.
shipping-expedited@v1 still has 1/1 chunks indexed despite being superseded by v2.
Retrieval returned both shipping-expedited@v1#0 and shipping-expedited@v2#0, presenting contradictory prices to the model.
Superseded chunk states express shipping costs $24.95.
Current chunk states express shipping costs $19.95.

ruled_out.reason: The configuration change only increased max_response_tokens and did not alter knowledge base indexing or shipping prices.

diagnosis.suggested_fix: De-index shipping-expedited@v1 so that only shipping-expedited@v2 is retrieved.

candidates.rationale: Multiple versions of the expedited shipping document ('shipping-expedited@v1' and 'shipping-expedited@v2') remain indexed simultaneously, exposing conflicting pricing information to retrieval.
The model may have misinterpreted the retrieved context or hallucinated pricing details between outdated and current shipping tiers.
The retriever returned older chunk versions alongside new ones due to lack of version filtering or thresholding.
